summary.text: 么 is the standardized simplified form of 麽, used in simplified Chinese for an interrogative particle. It is also recorded as a variant associated with 幺, but the evidence does not establish how that graphic relationship arose.

formation.text: The dossier supports two whole-character relationships: 么 is recorded as a variant of 幺, and the 1956 scheme standardized it as the simplified counterpart of 麽. It does not establish an internal component structure or the graphic path linking 么 with 幺, so the construction is best classified as derived through simplification, with the variant association separately qualified.

history.text: The association of 么 with 幺 is recorded as a variant relationship, but the evidence does not establish its timing or graphic mechanism. The selected seal-style image depicts 幺 in a modern redraw of the Shuowen seal-script tradition; it is not an early form of 么.
The 1956 simplification scheme explicitly paired 么 with 麽 as standardized counterparts. This whole-character relation does not establish an internal component substitution in 么.

uncertainties.text: No inspected paleographic evidence establishes the earliest forms or graphic evolution of 么 and 幺, or the precise graphic basis of their recorded variant relationship.

senses.text: A small/fine use is cited for 么, including in 么虫. The evidence does not establish whether this use continues a meaning associated with 幺 or 麽.

senses.gloss: interrogative or sentence-final particle; postposed element
senses.text: In simplified Chinese, 么 writes interrogative and postposed uses also written 麼 in traditional Chinese. Cited literary examples attest these uses but do not date the earliest surviving spelling.

limitations.text: The evidence does not establish a semantic transition from small/fine to particle uses. Proposed histories involving 何物, 物, and 無 concern the spoken interrogative word and its spellings; they do not establish how the graph 么 was formed or borrowed.

overview.text: 么 is the standardized simplified form of 麽 and is used for an interrogative particle in simplified Chinese.

takeaway.text: The separately recorded small/fine use does not establish that the particle developed from that meaning.

relationships.text: 么 is recorded as a variant associated with 幺, though the evidence does not establish the timing or precise graphic mechanism.
